title: Vortex Peach Apricot Apple 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salt Peach Apricot Apple blends the delicate sweetness of Peach with the smooth, juicy notes of Apricot and the crisp, fresh finish of Apple. This fruity medley is bright and well-balanced, offering a flavour that’s both refreshing and satisfying. With its 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers smooth throat hits and full-bodied flavour, making it ideal for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits and starter systems. The nic salt formula ensures fast nicotine relief and a comfortable vaping experience. Tidal Vape Vortex Nic Salts come in a 10ml format, providing a longer-lasting and less wasteful alternative to disposable vape devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Peach Apricot Apple is a versatile option for vapers seeking layered and uplifting fruit blends.
